ci_method: equal-tailed percentile interval of the replicate distribution (numpy linear interpolation)
p_value_method: two-sided percentile-inversion bootstrap p-value: p = min(1, 2 * (min(#{d* <= 0}, #{d* >= 0}) + 1) / (R + 1)) over the R finite replicate differences d*; p < alpha exactly when 0 lies outside the equal-tailed (1 - alpha) percentile interval, up to the add-one Monte Carlo correction that keeps p >= 2 / (R + 1)
resampling: components drawn with replacement globally; same weights for every model and seed
